verses.text_en: And I proceeded to where things were chaotic.
verses.text_hr: Nastavih do mjesta gdje je sve bilo kaotično.

verses.text_en: And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh nešto strašno: nisam vidio ni neba iznad ni čvrsto utemeljene zemlje, nego kaotično i užasno mjesto.

verses.text_en: And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire.
verses.text_hr: Ondje vidjeh sedam nebeskih zvijezda svezanih zajedno, nalik velikim gorama koje gore ognjem.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’
verses.text_hr: Tada upitah: ‘Zbog kojega su grijeha svezane i zašto su bačene ovamo?’

verses.text_en: Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth?
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom i njihov starješina, reče mi: ‘Henok, zašto pitaš i zašto žarko želiš istinu?

verses.text_en: These are of the number of the stars ⌜of heaven⌝ which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’
verses.text_hr: One pripadaju zvijezdama ⌜nebeskim⌝ koje su prestupile Gospodinovu zapovijed; ovdje su svezane dok se ne navrši deset tisuća godina, vrijeme određeno njihovim grijesima.’

verses.text_en: And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture.
verses.text_hr: Odatle odoh na drugo mjesto, još strašnije od prethodnoga, i vidjeh užas: velik oganj koji je gorio i plamtio; mjesto bijaše rascijepljeno sve do ponora i puno golemih silaznih stupova ognja. Nisam mogao vidjeti ni njegov opseg ni veličinu, niti sam ih mogao naslutiti.

verses.text_en: Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’
verses.text_hr: Tada rekoh: ‘Kako je strašno ovo mjesto i kako ga je užasno gledati!’

verses.text_en: Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’
verses.text_hr: Uriel, jedan od svetih anđela koji bijaše sa mnom, odgovori: ‘Henok, zašto te obuzimaju takav strah i užas?’ Odgovorih: ‘Zbog ovoga strašnoga mjesta i prizora muke.’

verses.text_en: And he said 〚unto me〛: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’
verses.text_hr: On mi 〚reče〛: ‘Ovo je mjesto tamnica anđela; ovdje će biti zatočeni zauvijek.’
